content: We Work Remotely: Remote jobs in design, programming, marketing and more https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs.rss We Work Remotely: Remote jobs in design, programming, marketing and more en-US 60 Orchard: Head of Sales/GTM Anywhere in the World Sales and Marketing Full-Time <img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0171/6494/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" /> <p> <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Wyoming, United States <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="http://orchard.co">http://orchard.co</a> </p> <p><strong>About Orchard</strong></p> <p>'Orchard' began as the in-house creator programme behind 'In Print We Trust'. That programme took the brand to over a billion views a month and the 13th most-mentioned fashion brand on TikTok UK, and put thousands of creators on contract. </p> <p>We have now launched it as a business in its own right, selling guaranteed organic views with product placement to brands.</p> <p>This is how brands grow now. Celsius, Bloom, Cal AI and Polymarket became big because thousands of creators had the product in their videos at the same time.</p> <p>The business is at multi six-figures in its first month operating from inbound. You'll build the sales side from scratch: pipeline, pricing, contracts, the first hires.</p> <p></p> <p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>What brands buy is simple: a number of views, at one CPM, guaranteed.&nbsp;You'll take the machine and find every way it can be sold. Some we can see: white-label it to agencies; sell it to labels as sound seeding; sell it to retailers and CPG brands as launch momentum; sell managed supply to creator platforms in the markets they can't cover. Some we can't see, and that's where you step in. Perhaps you've got a way in at an AI lab that buys creator footage by the thousand hours, or another channel we aren't even aware of yet.</p> <p>This is a high-ownership opportunity to build/run sales/growth. So you need to have built revenue from a standing start before, at an agency, a platform or your own company, and have hired and run people who sell.</p> <p><strong>Requirements</strong></p> <ul> <li>You are comfortable being first: no marketing team, no SDR, a product whose packaging you will change.</li> <li>You have extreme agency and can be scrappy/inventive.</li> <li>You've personally closed $100K+ sized deals with agencies, brands or platforms, and you've hired or managed people who sell.</li> <li>Experience selling to SaaS, ecommerce, DTC, retail and founder-led companies.</li> <li>You know the UK and US agency and creator world well enough to get 20 meetings from your own contacts in month one.</li> <li>You understand DTC/ecommerce and Meta advertising.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>£65,000 - £95,000 base + commission</li> <li>Unlimited PTO</li> <li>6% pension contribution</li> <li>Travel budget for meetings, US trips included</li> <li>Remote first, with a London desk when you want one</li> </ul> <p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/orchard-head-of-sales-gtm">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/orchard-head-of-sales-gtm</a></p> Wed, 30 Sep 2026 12:59:11 +0000 Fri, 30 Oct 2026 12:59:11 +0000 https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/orchard-head-of-sales-gtm https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/orchard-head-of-sales-gtm Storyblok: Documentation Engineer II Anywhere in the World Sales and Marketing Full-Time <p> <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote </p> <div class="content-intro"><p>Storyblok is a headless CMS that enables marketers and developers to create with joy and publish with confidence. It empowers you to deliver structured and consistent content everywhere: websites, apps, AI search, and beyond.</p> <p>Legendary brands like Virgin Media O2, Oatly, and TomTom use Storyblok to make a bigger, faster market impact.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>WHAT IS IN IT FOR YOU</strong></p> <p>You will be joining a growing company where you can contribute to many “firsts”. Plus these benefits:</p> <ul> <li>Monthly remote work stipend (home internet costs, electricity). Home office equipment package right at the start (laptop, keyboard, monitor…)</li> <li>Home office equipment upgrade (furniture, ear plugs …) or membership to a local co-working space after your onboarding</li> <li>Sick leave benefit, parental leave and 25 days of annual leave plus your local national holidays</li> <li>Personal development fund for courses, books, conferences, and material</li> <li>The annual international team-building trip, quarterly and monthly online get-togethers</li> <li>As a fully remote company, with work-life balance at its core, you’ll enjoy flexible schedules</li> <li>An international team that loves to have fun at work and works hard together to accomplish shared goals</li> </ul></div><h2><strong>JOB SUMMARY</strong></h2> <p>As a <strong>Documentation Engineer II</strong>, you will be responsible for the creation and maintenance of documentation related to company products, processes, and training materials. This role involves collaborating with various teams to ensure that information is accurate, accessible, and effectively supports internal and external users.</p> <h2><strong>ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Become a Storyblok and headless CMS authority, helping developers, partner agencies, and customers to understand Storyblok and its capabilities, implement a headless architecture on their projects easily, and get the best out of Storyblok’s features.</li> <li>Help developers understand and get value out of Storyblok by creating and maintaining developer tutorials, developer guides, FAQ entries, and API documentation.</li> <li>Write sample applications, prototypes, and code samples to showcase the power and flexibility of Storyblok and the headless approach to content management.</li> <li>Helping teammates overcome obstacles, resolving blockers, and completing work tasks.</li> <li>Seeking guidance to increase your own experience. Sometimes mentoring teammates in an open, respectful, flexible, and empathetic manner.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE</strong></h2> <ul> <li>5+ years of experience in web development.</li> <li>Proven experience in technical writing and documentation.</li> <li>Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field or equivalent experience.</li> <li>Experience with CMS in general; experience with Headless CMS is a plus.</li> <li>Thorough knowledge of consuming RESTful APIs. GraphQL APIs is a plus.</li> <li>Working knowledge of at least one of the modern JavaScript frameworks (e.g., Vue, React, Next, Nuxt, Astro, or Svelte) along with its fundamental principles.</li> <li>Working knowledge of Git.</li> <li>Strong communication and interpersonal skills.</li> <li>Good problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities.</li> <li>High attention to detail.</li> <li>Continuous learning mindset to stay updated on industry trends and best practices in documentation.
